short: A German battlecruiser known as the 'Iron Dog' for her resilience at Jutland, where she helped sink two British battlecruisers.
full:
Commissioned into the Imperial German Navy on 1 September 1914, SMS Derfflinger was the lead ship of her class and one of the most advanced battlecruisers of the war. Her design featured flush decks and a well-protected hull, making her exceptionally difficult to sink. She possessed heavy 12-inch main battery guns arranged in superfiring turrets, providing formidable firepower.

At the Battle of Jutland in 1916, Derfflinger delivered fatal blows to the British battlecruisers HMS Queen Mary and HMS Invincible, while sustaining twenty-one major hits herself. Despite severe flooding and devastation, she survived to limp back to port, earning immense respect for her structural integrity. She was interned with the rest of the High Seas Fleet after the armistice and scuttled at Scapa Flow in June 1919.
